title: Rockstar Says GTA 6 Will Speed Up Future Game Development
description: Rockstar says GTA 6's development tools and team will let them build the next game faster, cutting the typical eight‑year wait.
youtubeTitle: Rockstar Says GTA 6 Will Reduce Future Game Development Time
socialHook: Rockstar says GTA 6 will let them build the next game faster than the eight‑year wait for GTA VI.

sections.heading: Rockstar’s Development Timeline Claim
paragraphs: According to a Bloomberg report by Jason Schreier, senior Rockstar staff said that the technology, tools and team built during GTA 6 will enable them to develop the next game more quickly, avoiding the eight‑year development cycle of GTA VI.

sections.heading: What Remains Unclear
paragraphs: Rockstar has not announced a specific release window for its next title, and the exact timeline has not been confirmed; the claim is based on an interview and not an official statement.
